cases.evidence_note: Pub. 525 (2025) p. 25, Example 30: a 2024 joint return with itemized deductions of $30,700 against a standard deduction of $29,200 and taxable income of $60,000; in 2025 a state income tax refund of $400, a medical reimbursement of $200 and a mortgage interest refund of $325, none more than deducted, with the income tax deducted more than $400 over the sales tax (refund.exc_tax No). Line 5d equals line 5e (no 2024 limit on taxes), so Worksheet 2a line 5 is blank and line 1a is the $400. Total $925 is under $1,500 (line 8), so all is included: $400 on Schedule 1 line 1 and $525 on line 8z, as the example states.

Pub. 525 (2025) p. 25, Example 32: a 2024 joint return with taxable income of $45,000, itemized deductions of $29,450 and a standard deduction of $29,200; $2,100 of 2024 itemized deductions recovered in 2025, none more than deducted (entered as another Schedule A item, deducted $3,000). Include $250, the smaller of $2,100 and $29,450 − $29,200. No state refund: line 1a is zero, so all of line 11 goes to line 8z.

Pub. 525 (2025) p. 26, Example 33: the facts of Example 32 except that line 14 of the 2024 Form 1040 was $200 more than line 11 (entered as line 11 $10,000 and line 14 $10,200), a negative taxable income of $200. Include $50 rather than $250.

Inputs constructed so that, as in Example 31, $2,500 of 2024 itemized deductions are recovered (a $500 state income tax refund and $2,000 of other items) and only $1,500 must be included (2024 single itemized deductions $16,100 less the $14,600 standard deduction). Line A is $500 ÷ $2,500 = 20%; line B $300 goes on Schedule 1 line 1 and line C $1,200 on line 8z, the example's figures.

Single for 2024, itemized deductions $14,000 under the $14,600 standard deduction; a $300 property tax refund (no 2024 limit on taxes, so Worksheet 2a passes it to line 1b). Line 8 is zero ("If the result is zero or less, stop here"), so nothing is included.

Single for 2024: Schedule A line 5d $15,000 limited to $10,000 on line 5e; refunds of $2,000 state income tax and $1,000 property tax. Worksheet 2a: line 3 $3,000, line 4 $5,000 (5d − 5e), line 3 not more than line 4, so none of the tax refunds is taxable (lines 7 and 8 zero). The $500 mortgage interest refund on line 2 is all included (line 8 $20,000 − $14,600 = $5,400), on line 8z; line 11 equals line 3, so line B is line 1a, zero.

As rec.salt_cap_absorbs with refunds of $4,000 state income tax and $2,000 property tax. Worksheet 2a: line 3 $6,000, line 4 $5,000, line 5 $1,000; line 7 = $1,000 × $4,000 ÷ $6,000 = $666.67 (ratio 0.666667, six places, amb.2025.rec_ratio_places) and line 8 = $1,000 × 0.333333 = $333.33. Line 3 of Worksheet 2 is $1,000.00, under line 8 ($5,400), so line 11 equals line 3: line B is line 1a ($666.67) on Schedule 1 line 1 and line C $333.33 on line 8z.

Pub. 525 (2025) p. 26, Example 34, the cap only: $1,700 of 2024 medical expenses of which only $200 was deducted; a $500 reimbursement in 2025. Only $200, the amount deducted, is included. The 2024 itemized deductions ($20,000 single, standard deduction $14,600) are constructed so that the standard deduction limit does not bind.

Single for 2024, itemized deductions $15,400 against $14,600: line 8 $800. Recoveries: a $1,000 state income tax refund (line 1a) and $3,000 of other items; line 3 $4,000, line 11 $800. Line A = $1,000 ÷ $4,000 = 25%; line B = $200 on Schedule 1 line 1; line C = $600 on line 8z.

The standard deduction was taken for 2024; a $300 property tax refund in 2025 is not income ("don’t include any of the recovery amount in your income"). Worksheet 2 is not used; line 8z is zero and the amount is not asked.
Money paid back in 2025 for something deducted for 2023: refused at rec.to_line8z (Worksheet 2, a separate worksheet for each year). The refused values are the evaluator's.

rec.to_line8z.form: Pub. 525, Worksheet 2 (a recovery for an earlier year)
rec.to_line8z.remedy: Money paid back for something paid or deducted before 2024 is figured on a separate worksheet with that year's return; that is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, "If you recovered amounts from more than 1 year, such as a state income tax refund from 2024 and a casualty loss reimbursement from 2023, complete a separate worksheet for each year"

s1.line8z.form: Pub. 525, Worksheet 2 (a recovery for an earlier year)
s1.line8z.remedy: Money paid back for something paid or deducted before 2024 is figured on a separate worksheet with that year's return; that is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, "If you recovered amounts from more than 1 year, such as a state income tax refund from 2024 and a casualty loss reimbursement from 2023, complete a separate worksheet for each year"

cases.evidence_note: Money paid back for a bad debt deducted without itemizing: refused at rec.to_line8z (Nonitemized Deduction Recoveries). The refused values are the evaluator's.

rec.to_line8z.form: Pub. 525, Nonitemized Deduction Recoveries and Amounts Recovered for Credits
rec.to_line8z.remedy: Money paid back for a deduction taken without itemizing (such as a bad debt) or for an item on which a credit was claimed is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 28, Nonitemized Deduction Recoveries, "If you recover an amount that you deducted in an earlier year when you were figuring your AGI, you must generally include the full amount"; p. 28, Amounts Recovered for Credits

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, footnote 2, "don’t enter more than the excess of your sales tax deduction over your state and local income tax you could have deducted"

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, "Use information from your tax return for the year the expense was deducted"

cases.evidence_note: Money paid back for 2024 property tax by a filer who owed AMT for 2024 (refund.exc_tax): refused at rec.line11 (Pub. 525, Subject to AMT). The refused values are the evaluator's.

rec.line11.form: Pub. 525, Itemized Deduction Recoveries (Unused tax credits, Subject to AMT, Capital gains)
rec.line11.remedy: Your 2024 alternative minimum tax, unused credits, 0% capital gain rate or sales tax choice means the 2024 tax is refigured to find how much of what was paid back is taxable; that is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, "If you were subject to the AMT or your tax credits reduced your tax to zero, see Unused tax credits and Subject to AMT under Itemized Deduction Recoveries"; p. 25, Capital gains, "you’ll have to refigure your tax for the earlier year to determine if the recovery must be included in your income"

cases.evidence_note: Negative 2024 taxable income (line 11 $10,000, line 14 $11,000) while a net operating loss is carried into 2025: refused at rec.line11 (Worksheet 2, footnote 4). The refused values are the evaluator's.

rec.line11.form: Pub. 525, Worksheet 2, line 10, and Form 172 (a net operating loss carryover)
rec.line11.remedy: Negative 2024 taxable income while a net operating loss is carried into 2025 must be adjusted for the carryover under the Instructions for Form 172; that is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 27, Worksheet 2, footnote 4, "Taxable income will have to be adjusted for any net operating loss carryover"
